urdu: "گرینڈ جامع مسجد" کے بیرونی برآمدے کس ملک کے امام باڑوں سے متاثر ہیں؟
english: The exterior corridors of the "Grand Jamia Mosque" are inspired by the Imam Bargahs of which country?
roman_1: "Grand Jamia Masjid" kay bairuni baramday kis mulk kay Imam Barghon say mutasir hain?
roman_2: "Grand Jamia Masjid" k baeruni baramday kis mulk k Imam Bargahon se mutasir hain?
roman_3: "Grand Jamia Masjid" ke bairooni baramday kis mulk ke Imam Bargahoon say mutasir hain?
